# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an opening range breakout, price often pulls back to the intraday VWAP, providing a high‑probability long entry. This leverages mean-reversion tendencies within a breakout context, where VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance during early-session trends.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price breaks above the opening range high (first 15‑minute bar) and subsequently closes above VWAP within 0.1% tolerance on a bullish candle (close > open), enter long at the close of that candle. Exit: Chart‑stop at the opening range low; take profit at 1.5R or trail 10% off the highest‑water‑mark using a chandelier trail. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time between 09:45‑10:30 EST, and price above the 20‑period EMA ribbon (bullish ribbon alignment).
